items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: it had Bill Evans on it; it had Tony Williams; Sam Rivers; Bill Evans’s drummer – I can’t remember what his name was now [Marty Morell]; it had Eddie Gomez; it had Ron Carter.

ctx.x: But it was a great album, with Bill Evans. Check it out: it had Bill Evans on it; it had Tony Williams; Sam Rivers; Bill Evans’s drummer – I can’t remember what his name was now [Marty Morell]; it had Eddie Gomez; it had Ron Carter. So it was truly an all-star album. Fact is, I'll look at the personnel when we get done down there.
